name: 127 Steps, No Reason
line: One hundred twenty-eight turns, one fight, no wound, no word — and the wanderer chose to begin the world again.

name: Six turns, nothing touched
line: The player walked five squares, met nothing, lost no blood, and wiped the world before anything could happen to them.

name: First Blood, Still Silent
line: Sixty-five turns of empty floor, then a fight that killed in four blows — and still not one word out loud.

name: Bare at the gate
line: The teaching floor's new welcome put a guard across the only walk, and the player deleted the world rather than replay a fight that resolves the same way twice.
